name: BIRD DOG LEFT
introduce:
Start on all fours, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.

Inhale, extend your left leg back and right arm forward. Hold for a few seconds, then exhale, draw your left knee and right elbow together to touch each other.

Repeat with steady breath.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure that your lifted leg is fully extended.
It works on your core, glutes, shoulders, and lower back.
This exercise can improve your stability.
Exhale when lifting your arm and opposite leg, and inhale when lowering them.
